title: National Health Mission and Health Schemes: High-Yield Essentials

steps.tx: The **National Health Mission** combines the National Rural Health Mission (NRHM, launched 5 April 2005) and the National Urban Health Mission (NUHM). NRHM aimed at accessible, affordable and reliable primary care in rural areas, mainly through the **ASHA** (Accredited Social Health Activist) cadre. Its goals included reducing infant mortality to 30 per 1,000 live births and maternal mortality to 100 per 1,00,000 live births.
steps.say: The National Health Mission brings together the National Rural Health Mission and the National Urban Health Mission. The rural mission was launched on the fifth of April 2005 and aimed at accessible, affordable and reliable primary care in villages, mainly through the ASHA, the Accredited Social Health Activist. Its national goals included reducing infant mortality to 30 per 1,000 live births and maternal mortality to 100 per 1,00,000 live births.

steps.tx: **RCH** (Reproductive and Child Health) was launched in October 1997 and has four components: family planning, child survival and safe motherhood, client approach to health care, and prevention of RTI/STI/HIV-AIDS. **RCH phase II** began on 1 April 2005 and emphasised **essential obstetric care**, **emergency obstetric care** and strengthening the referral system.
steps.say: The Reproductive and Child Health programme was launched in October 1997. It has four components: family planning, child survival and safe motherhood, client approach to health care, and prevention of RTI, STI and HIV-AIDS. Phase two began on the first of April 2005 and stressed essential obstetric care, emergency obstetric care and a stronger referral system.

steps.tx: **RMNCH+A** extends maternal, newborn, child and adolescent health care. The 12th Five Year Plan set three goals for 2017: infant mortality of 25 per 1,000 live births, maternal mortality of 100 per 1,00,000 live births, and a total fertility rate of 2.1. Anaemia reduction at 6 per cent annually is a coverage target, not a goal.
steps.say: RMNCH plus A extends care to maternal, newborn, child and adolescent health. The twelfth Five Year Plan set three goals for 2017: infant mortality of 25 per 1,000 live births, maternal mortality of 100 per 1,00,000 live births, and a total fertility rate of 2.1. Reducing adolescent anaemia at six per cent a year is a coverage target rather than one of these goals.

steps.tx: Under the **untied fund**, sub-centres and health facilities receive flexible money for local planning. Under **Kayakalp**, hospitals are judged on cleanliness and infection control. The **Free Drugs and Diagnostics Initiative** gives essential medicines and tests free at public facilities. **NQAS** (National Quality Assurance Standards) certifies quality of health facilities. **ABDM** (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission) builds the digital health ID and records.
steps.say: Under the untied fund, sub-centres and health facilities receive flexible money for local planning. Kayakalp judges hospitals on cleanliness and infection control. The Free Drugs and Diagnostics Initiative provides essential medicines and tests free at public facilities. NQAS, the National Quality Assurance Standards, certifies the quality of health facilities. The Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission builds the digital health ID and records.

steps.tx: **Rogi Kalyan Samiti** is a hospital-level society that manages untied funds for patient welfare. Remember that the NRHM phrase is integration, not formation, of vertical programmes at district and state levels through the **District Health Mission** and **State Health Mission**. Mixing these up is a common exam trap.
